lines.label: Heart line
lines.interpretation: A long, gently curving heart line suggests you feel things deeply and show warmth in small, steady ways.

lines.label: Head line
lines.interpretation: Your head line slopes softly, a sign of an imaginative mind that likes to turn ideas over before settling on one.

lines.label: Life line
lines.interpretation: A wide arc around the thumb is read as lively energy and a love of trying new places and routines.

lines.label: Fate line
lines.interpretation: No clear fate line shows here, which palm readers often take as a path you shape freely as you go.

lines.label: Sun line
lines.interpretation: A faint sun line hints at a quiet creative streak that shines brightest when you share it with friends.

palm.summary: Your palm paints a picture of a warm, curious person who leads with feeling and enjoys a bit of adventure.

love.how_you_love: You love with patience and attention, remembering the little details that make people feel seen.
love.ideal_partner: Someone playful and open who enjoys long talks as much as spontaneous weekend plans.
love.challenges: You can keep worries to yourself; saying them out loud tends to bring you closer.

career.strengths: You connect ideas in fresh ways and bring calm energy to group work.
career.challenges: Routine tasks can feel slow to you, so variety keeps your spark alive.
